card.name: Aluminum threshold number in warnings
card.fires_on: Mostly the number 4 in 'greater than 4 to 5 mcg/kg/day' in the aluminum toxicity warning for parenteral products. Also scattered single words or digits in dosing and storage ranges, and a few web-text words like 'to' and 'through'.
